# libretro ABI headers

`libretro.h` and `libretro_vulkan.h` are unmodified from libretro/libretro-common commit
`a3194c18ba65ef89734e1898a2f61403c255d368`.

Source: https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/blob/a3194c18ba65ef89734e1898a2f61403c255d368/include/libretro.h

Vulkan ABI source: https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/blob/a3194c18ba65ef89734e1898a2f61403c255d368/include/libretro_vulkan.h

The headers contain their MIT license notices. They are ABI declarations only;
RetroArch application code is not linked or included.
